description: Rotate and/or flip an existing video and render a new output file. Supports right-angle rotations plus horizontal and vertical flips; the input video is not modified.

angle.description: Clockwise rotation angle in degrees. Supported values are 0, 90, 180, and 270.
angle.title: Angle

flip_horizontal.description: Mirror the video horizontally after rotation when true.
flip_horizontal.title: Flip Horizontal

flip_vertical.description: Mirror the video vertically after rotation when true.
flip_vertical.title: Flip Vertical

input_path.description: Absolute path to an existing local video file. The input file is read only.
input_path.title: Input Path

output_path.description: Destination video path. Auto-generated when omitted; an existing supplied path may be overwritten.
output_path.title: Output Path

name: video_rotate
title: Rotate or flip video
